name: Athena OS
headline: Train AI on all your data.
definition: Athena OS is an open-source, self-hosted no-code AI training and visual inspection platform across photos, video, audio, handwriting, documents, motion, and spreadsheets. Apache-2.0.
description: Train AI on all your data: photos, audio, handwriting, documents, motion, and spreadsheets. Self-hosted, no-code, Apache-2.0.
features: No-code multimodal training recipes across Vision, Audio, Handwriting OCR, Documents, Motion, and Spreadsheets
Ask plain-language questions on photos or 6-frame video clips with counts and marked regions
Consistent Project to Feedback lifecycle with modality-specific quality gates
Open-source Qwen by default or any OpenAI-compatible AI, self-hosted under Apache-2.0

founder.name: Ts. Dominic Mathew
founder.summary: Ts. Dominic Mathew is Co-Founder and CTO of Stratetics Experts. He publishes Athena OS as open-source multimodal AI training tooling and builds Inspec-Ther for solar inspection.

athenaVision.name: Athena Vision
athenaVision.summary: In-house Segment and Detect models for assisted annotation: label one picture, then review AI drafts on the rest. Bounding boxes, masks, and export to COCO, YOLO or VOC. This is the vision stack behind Inspec-Ther.

inspecTher.name: Inspec-Ther
inspecTher.description: AI-driven thermal inspection of solar PV assets.
inspecTher.modelNote: Inspec-Ther is the solar inspection product. Athena Vision (Segment and Detect) is the in-house vision stack behind it. This page is the open-source Athena OS toolkit, not the hosted Inspec-Ther app.

faq.a: Athena OS is an open-source, self-hosted AI training and inspection platform. Today you can inspect photos or 6-frame clips in plain words and train custom detectors, while the multimodal roadmap expands no-code training across sound, handwriting, documents, motion, and spreadsheets.

faq.q: Do I need to write code?
faq.a: No. Pick an intended outcome recipe or ready-made inspection check, label samples visually, and review quality in plain words — no ML boilerplate required.
On your own server or local CPU/GPU (with optional Athena Nodes). Apache-2.0. Your media and training data stay on your network.
It ships with open Qwen vision-language support and modular training recipes, or connects to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, vLLM, Ollama, and LM Studio.
Ts. Dominic Mathew, Co-Founder and CTO of Stratetics Experts. His portfolio is dominic.strateticsxp.com.

faq.q: How does this relate to Inspec-Ther?
faq.a: Inspec-Ther is the solar PV thermal inspection product at inspec-ther.com. The in-house vision stack behind it is Athena Vision (Segment and Detect). Athena OS on this page is the open-source toolkit, not the hosted Inspec-Ther app.
